_comment: Example AGS audit-log entry. Every decision (allow / deny / require_approval) produces one. Append-only; commitment-anchored. This is what auditors / regulators / post-mortem teams read.

_principle_mapping.1_deterministic_policy: decision.outcome = 'require_approval' produced by OPA evaluation in 2.7 ms; principal could not bypass
_principle_mapping.2_identity_per_agent: principal.identity.id = SPIFFE per-agent ID; tenant_id is verified on the identity attestation
_principle_mapping.3_tamper_evident_audit: tamper_evidence.this_record_hash chains to previous_record_hash; Merkle batch will be anchored to external TSA on close
_principle_mapping.4_policy_as_code: policy.policy_version + policy_artifact_hash pin the exact rule set; reproducible audit five years later
_principle_mapping.5_privilege_rings: principal.ring = 2 — captured in record; some actions only allowed for Ring 0
_principle_mapping.6_kill_switch_slo: (not visible in single record; SLO monitoring queries aggregate this audit stream)
_principle_mapping.7_tool_poisoning_detection: action.tool_name = 'approval_engine.issue' — present in signed tool manifest; verified at evaluation time
_principle_mapping.8_shadow_agent_discovery: principal.identity.id is registered; (shadow-discovery would flag unregistered identities at scan time)
_principle_mapping.9_trust_scoring: principal.trust_score = 0.94 with full input lineage; consumed by policy rules that gate on trust
_principle_mapping.10_governance_aware_training: (not visible in single record; training-time provenance lives on the model side)
